permissions.comment: Safety baseline for driving CVS. Read-only cvs is auto-allowed; anything that touches the cluster (exec-json/run-json/baseline capture/raw ssh) must be human-approved; a few catastrophic local shell patterns are denied. The OPERATING environment (laptop/head node/MCP) should apply the same or stricter. NOTE: exec-json runs commands REMOTELY, so a remote destructive command is gated by the exec-json approval below, NOT the local deny list — the real controls are the least-privilege SSH user, scoped sudo, and these ask rules (see .claude/skills/cvs-operate 'Safety & SSH access').
